subject: Mythology
title: The Four Yugas: Ages of the Universe
description: One-minute skill: The Four Yugas: Ages of the Universe.

hook.text: Hindu mythology says time is not a line but a circle, repeating in four great ages that slowly decay.

buildup.text: The first age, Satya Yuga, was a golden era of truth. Each age that follows is shorter and more corrupt.

discovery.text: We currently live in Kali Yuga, the darkest age, filled with greed, conflict, and spiritual ignorance.

twist.text: After Kali Yuga ends in destruction, the golden age returns. The cycle has no beginning and no end.

climax.text: Hindu time spans billions of years. One day of Brahma equals 4.32 billion human years — close to Earth's actual age.

punchline.text: Ancient mythology and modern science agree: the universe is very, very old.

quiz.question: Which age are we currently living in according to Hindu mythology?
options: Satya Yuga, the golden age of truth
Kali Yuga, the darkest age of conflict
Dvapara Yuga, the age of heroes
